entities.name: Donner Rus
entities.description: Potion-master and master poisoner from Dominaria, famed throughout the five kingdoms.

entities.name: Vaan
entities.description: Man whose people were enslaved by a dragon; sought Rus's help to kill it.

entities.name: Dragon engine
entities.description: Dragon that enslaved Vaan's people, a dragon engine immune to Rus's spells and poisons.

events.summary: Vaan asks Rus to help kill the dragon that enslaved his people; Rus goes along pretending to accept.
events.quote: Rus was approached by Vaan , who wanted him to help kill the dragon that had enslaved Vaan and his people.

events.summary: Near the lair, Rus puts the group to sleep with herbs and sends Tania in to gather dragon parts.
events.quote: He then sent Tania into the lair

events.summary: The dragon proves awake and a dragon engine; Tania is saved by Vaan, and Rus is incinerated.

relations.quote: Tania Cayce , his apprentice, sometimes feared that he might slip her something
